test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: To gather intelligence about demand and supply of drugs in border villages, Punjab police launched which mission in association with Border Security Force (BSF) and Village Defence Committees (VDCs) in June 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mission Nishchay**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Punjab police launched **Mission Nishchay** in collaboration with BSF and VDCs in June 2024.
 
• The mission aims to gather intelligence on the **demand and supply of drugs** in border villages.
 
• This initiative is part of the broader efforts to **combat the drug menace** in Punjab, particularly in areas close to the India-Pakistan border.
 
• Mission Nishchay involves active participation from **local communities** through Village Defence Committees (VDCs).
 
• Cooperation with the Border Security Force (BSF) is crucial for the **successful implementation** of this mission.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Border Security Force (BSF)**

 
 
• BSF is one of the five Central Armed Police Forces of India, tasked with guarding India's land border during peace time and preventing transnational crime.
 
• Established on 1 December 1965, BSF is under the administrative control of the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• It plays a critical role in **counter-insurgency and counter-terrorism operations**.
 
• BSF personnel are often involved in anti-smuggling operations, including drug interdiction.
 
 
 
• **Village Defence Committees (VDCs)**
 
 
• VDCs are community-based groups formed to assist in maintaining law and order in rural and border areas.
 
• They provide local intelligence and support security forces in their operations.
 
• VDC members are usually volunteers from the local population, enhancing community participation in security efforts.
 
• These committees are instrumental in **bridging the gap between security forces and local communities**.
 
 
 
• **Drug Menace in Punjab**
 
 
• Punjab has faced significant challenges related to drug abuse, with a high prevalence of opioid addiction among its youth.
 
• The state borders Pakistan, making it vulnerable to drug trafficking routes.
 
• Efforts to combat drug abuse include **rehabilitation programs, awareness campaigns, and strict law enforcement**.
 
• Government initiatives aim to reduce demand and supply of illegal drugs through comprehensive strategies.
 
 
 
• **Drug Trafficking**
 
 
• Drug trafficking is the illegal trade involving the cultivation, manufacture, distribution, and sale of substances subject to drug prohibition laws.
 
• It is a global black market economy, often linked with organized crime and terrorism.
 
• Efforts to combat drug trafficking include international cooperation, stringent regulations, and intelligence-sharing among nations.
 
• Effective border security and community involvement are critical in curbing this illegal activity.
